name: OVH
recent: OVH 于 2026 年 11 月 24 日签署谅解备忘录，并发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。此前，公司于 11 月 16 日公布多项提案，并于 9 月 14 日召开特别股东大会，通过以 RM10.0 million 收购 Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd 全部股权（以每股 RM0.20 发行 50,000,000 股新股支付）及业务多元化至建筑业的决议。
notable: 特别股东大会通过以 RM10.0 million 收购 Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd 全部股权，并以每股 RM0.20 发行 50,000,000 股新股支付。
risks: 执行董事兼首席执行官 Willie Ho Huat Voon 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日出售合计 500,000 股普通股。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 26 日公告重大诉讼。
根据 ESOS 发行 21,500,000 股新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。

recent_en: OVH signed a memorandum of understanding on 24 November 2026 and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. Earlier, the company announced multiple proposals on 16 November and held an EGM on 14 September where shareholders approved the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd for RM10.0 million (satisfied via 50,000,000 new shares at RM0.20 each) and diversification into the construction business.
notable_en: Signed a memorandum of understanding (24 Nov 2026).
EGM approved the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd for RM10.0 million, satisfied via 50,000,000 new shares at RM0.20 each.
risks_en: Executive Director and CEO Willie Ho Huat Voon disposed a total of 500,000 ordinary shares on 6 November 2026.
The company announced material litigation on 26 October 2026.
Issuance of 21,500,000 new shares under the ESOS may dilute existing shareholders.
